_doc: Each real capital's and city's kept street plan (the design director, b618 and b625). A city's plan is laid from its own name: plan 1 from 'streets:<town>', plan n from 'streets:<town>#n'. Each city keeps the first plan of its own sequence that, fought as it will be fought (its own river or shore in the lie of each of its real attacks, on its kind's 24 equal tickets), sits within 7 points of its kind and runs no more than one fight in ten to the clock. Picked by that rule, never by eye. A city not listed keeps plan 1.
Two real cities share a town's name (Birmingham in the Midlands and in Alabama): 'shared' gives each its own key by its province's name, so no two cities share a plan. A plan is listed by that key.
Stalingrad (b625(2)): its strip on, tested by the bars (within a tenth of its kind, no more than one fight in ten to the clock); its plan 2 is the first to meet them.

Checked again on fresh fights against the kind's own cities on the same fights; a city that read past 7 there walked its sequence again on that test and keeps the first plan that passes. Belgrade: none of its first ten brings its lie with the Sava on the defence's flank within 7; it keeps plan 1 (within a tenth) until the design director rules.
